readme:
# Supermaven

Inline AI completions from Supermaven. The extension downloads its own completion engine on first activation and asks you to sign in — the free tier needs only an email address.

This is the unmodified extension published on Open VSX, pinned to a specific version and verified to work in Diode. You need your own Supermaven account; Diode neither resells nor proxies the service.

## What works in Diode

Inline completions appear as ghost text while you type: Tab accepts, Esc dismisses. The extension spawns its own engine process and reports its state in the status bar.

## What does not

The chat side panel is a webview, and Diode does not implement webviews — the panel never opens, and the commands that drive it (New Chat, History, Settings, Select Model, Add to Chat, Edit with Supermaven, Fix with Supermaven) do nothing. Signing in to Supermaven Pro opens a browser, which is not available in every terminal session; the free tier asks only for an email and works entirely inside the editor.
